mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_table (writer, category, title, content) VALUES (#{writer}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT category,title,writer,created_at FROM board_table ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT category,title,writer,created_at FROM board_table ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offSet}
SELECT board_id AS boardId, category AS category, title, writer, content FROM board_table WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
